headline: No API change affects the bot today and the research was thin, so there are two ideas: rule changes you make mid-day wait until tomorrow, and a one-tap 'did I follow my plan?' grade at 21:00 that /week sets next to your P&L.

ideas.title: Rule changes wait until tomorrow
ideas.why: Your limits (leverage, trade cap, loss limit) live in .env, so a restart after a loss can loosen them on the spot. Have the bot save each day's limits at 08:00; any looser value seen later that day is ignored until the next brief, which says what you changed.

ideas.title: Nightly plan grade, 1 to 5
ideas.why: Add five buttons to the 21:00 reminder: 'How well did you follow your plan today?' Store the tap; /week shows each day's grade next to its P&L and trade count. You learn whether your red days are bad-luck days or broken-plan days, in your own words.
